assets.name: crouching-unicorn-with-gold-horn
assets.description: A low crouching gray-green unicorn with a long horizontal gilded horn, a pointed mane, folded front legs and extended rear legs. Part of the Walters W.82 Marginalia set.

provenance.title: Initial “D” with nimbed apostle and pseudo-inscribed scroll; unicorn, mermaid, and hunting scene in margin

extraction.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the referenced ORIGINAL historical manuscript detail. Make a faithful transparent cutout of ONLY the specified complete painted subject. Keep the original pose, proportions, colors, hand-drawn contours and slight scan softness. Preserve every actual limb, prop and delicate painted stroke; do not invent missing parts or new detail. Opaque pale skin/eyes/painted surfaces stay opaque; genuine gaps between limbs and props and around the subject are transparent. Remove all parchment, text, foliate manuscript borders, unrelated neighbor figures, isolated marks and stains. Smooth fine antialiased edges; no coarse binary steps, polygon outlines, paper fringe, black ground line, shadow, sharpened modern cartoon or extra texture. Preserve the original figure aspect and its relative anatomy. Subject: the complete original pale gray-green unicorn crouching/running low and facing LEFT, including its unusually long narrow horizontal GOLD horn projecting left, dark mane spikes above the head, original eye and muzzle ink curls, bent front legs with original split hooves beneath the chest, low long torso, back legs extended to the right and original thin curled tail. Keep the original very wide low silhouette, approximately 3.1 times wider than tall; do not make an upright standing unicorn, shorten the horn, add hooves or thicken the body. Preserve the golden leaf glint on the horn and its original dark tip. Exclude all lettering below, parchment and black photography margin above. No invented ground line.

transparent_cleanup.method: Clear alpha <= 2/255 only more than three native pixels from alpha > 8/255; clear hidden RGB at alpha zero. Real edge alpha and visible color retained.

assets.description: A hand painted white wave with alternating white dots and two white bounding lines on blue. Part of the Walters W.82 Marginalia set.

provenance.title: Initial “D” with nimbed apostle and pseudo-inscribed scroll; unicorn, mermaid, and hunting scene in margin

extraction.method: Original painted band RGB with continuous native edge alpha. One rigid 2.0 degree counterclockwise orientation correction, bicubic interpolation, no scaling or elastic changes. Interior paint remains opaque, including original pale pattern and blue filled artwork body; only exterior parchment is removed.
extraction.vector_method: Withheld: a simplified vector would lose original paint texture and irregular contours.

join_adjustment.method: average matching source collars; interior columns 2 through width-3 unchanged
join_adjustment.source_cycle_verification: The inspected original blue line filler contains five consecutive white wave cycles, each with a dot above the low portion and a dot below the high portion. The selected interior cycle retains BOTH alternating dot phases and both original horizontal white lines. The gold pip and curled endpoint are finite end decorations and are excluded.

repeat_build.corner_method: Mitered reflections of the exact same native unit, using the repository’s four phase-matched corner geometry. Derived corners are distinct from the original fixed printer-frame corners.

review.notes: Viewed the original full band, source-coordinate phase detail, complete native motif period, five repeats and all four miter corners on dark backgrounds. Original blue paint is the artwork field; external parchment removed. Continuous native alpha, audited rigid deskew, no upscaling or elastic shaping. Only two collar columns joined; phase-matched corners use the same original unit. PNG-only preserves paint texture.
